example_captions: Fragments of time — hand-painted on naturally shed bark from a 200-year-old pine at Tyntesfield. Quiet detail for spaces that invite stillness.
One of a kind · Rooted in nature · Made with intention. A piece shaped by slow observation and the gentle discipline of working by hand.
Not paintings on canvas — fragments of a real tree, from a real place, made precious. Bark & Grain, Bristol.
